item.title: BRICS declaration aligns with Iran’s key positions: Gharibabadi
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs Kazem Gharibabadi has emphasized that BRICS’ New Delhi Declaration aligns with Iran’s positions on key issues, including opposition to unilateral sanctions, condemnation of attacks on peaceful nuclear facilities, support for Iran’s World Trade Organization (WTO) membership bid, and backing for Palestinian rights.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86262089/BRICS-declaration-aligns-with-Iran-s-key-positions-Gharibabadi

Tehran, IRNA – Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs Kazem Gharibabadi has emphasized that BRICS’ New Delhi Declaration aligns with Iran’s positions on key issues, including opposition to unilateral sanctions, condemnation of attacks on peaceful nuclear facilities, support for Iran’s World Trade Organization (WTO) membership bid, and backing for Palestinian rights.

item.title: Why Iran seeks permanent end to war, not temporary ceasefire?
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Republic of Iran has emphasized that the key objective in the ongoing war is to eliminate the threat and secure a decisive and permanent end to the war, stressing that a temporary ceasefire without guarantees against renewed aggression would not provide lasting stability.

item.title: Iran’s Armenian Olympics held in Tehran
item.description: The 57th Armenian Olympics of Iran kicked off on September 9, 2026 at the Ararat Stadium in Tehran, with the presence of Minister of Culture Reza Salehi Amiri, and Armenian representatives in Parliament, among other attendees. A classic car exhibition was also held.

Original source: https://en.irna.ir/photo/86261806/Iran-s-Armenian-Olympics-held-in-Tehran

The 57th Armenian Olympics of Iran kicked off on September 9, 2026 at the Ararat Stadium in Tehran, with the presence of Minister of Culture Reza Salehi Amiri, and Armenian representatives in Parliament, among other attendees. A classic car exhibition was also held.
